FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Audio Visual Solutions Inc. specializes in the retail sale and rental of high-quality audio and visual equipment, including televisions, amplifiers, speakers, projectors, and professional lighting systems. We pride ourselves on offering new products exclusively, ensuring that all equipment meets safety and performance standards. Our rental services cater to various events such as corporate functions, weddings, and private parties, with a comprehensive inventory managed through an effective inventory control system. Installation and repair services are provided by certified technicians with significant experience, allowing us to maintain high professional standards. To safeguard our operations, we adhere to strict security measures at our dedicated retail location and ensure that all equipment is regularly maintained and tested.

Our business specializes in the sale and servicing of audio and visual equipment, and as part of our operations, we engage in video rentals for customers looking to enjoy a variety of films and media.
